context: Naoko and Sho-young watch comedy show together at the ramen shop closing.
purpose: Aunt and child sharing simple laughter.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おばちゃん、この番組、面白い!
lines.en: Auntie, this show is so funny!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded delight. Lean forward slightly. Quick energy but not frantic — a child genuinely charmed. Warm on 'Auntie,' eager on the show name.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Right? It really cracks me up!
lines.style: Loud, brassy Kansai warmth. Animated, shoulders loose. Genuine laugh underneath — not performing, but generous with her joy. Quick and generous on the delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: My belly hurts from laughing so much!
lines.style: Soft giggle threaded through the words. Small, genuine — not exaggerated. Breathless a bit, like he can barely get the sentence out. Warm complicity with Auntie.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Watching it together like this is the best part.
lines.style: Warm, genuine fondness. A little slower than before — she's noticing him noticing her. Brassy still, but with something tender underneath. Eyes on him as much as the screen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Let's watch it again next time!
lines.style: Bright, open enthusiasm. Quick on 'again.' Soft urgency — not demanding, but hopeful. The small voice of a child securing a promise. Warm on the end.
